events.speaker: FINA
events.text: Quiet, now. He's been fought twice today already and he's finished being asked politely by strangers. Stand where he can see you and keep your hands still.

events.speaker: FINA
events.text: There. He walked up on his own four feet and nobody laid a whip on him. My father says a rope only repeats what your body already asked. He's right about horses and about very little else.

events.speaker: FINA
events.text: Better pay, and my own say in which horse I ride and on what day. That was always the only offer I'd have taken. My reata, my terms, and nobody starts a green colt on this place but me.

events.speaker: FINA
events.text: I run hot. Everyone tells me so as though it were news to me. You never once tried to cool me down. Don't you start.
